prediction: before feedback; minimum normalized entropy route; Frozen wins ties
reset: all model, optimizer, reliability and feedback memory state at each intensity
context_online: current plus up to four previous paid labels and source replay
metrics: macro PR/RC/F1; pre-feedback online; source forgetting in percentage points

routing.score: negative normalized predictive entropy; larger is better
routing.heads: learned routing and query heads fixed and bypassed
routing.trace: frozen/context_route_score are negative entropy; individual entropies also recorded

normalizer.fitting_scope: TRAIN cache only; natural-prevalence weighted per-sign reservoir moments; nonzero targets

protocol.scope: one short TRAIN pass over 0/1/3; prefixes of full-size shuffled domains, original full-domain cap
protocol.limitation: This is not a reconstruction of the complete original v2 training trajectory.

actor_experiment.routing: unchanged; original raw-state routing, paid-feedback updates
actor_experiment.balance_scope: natural TRAIN weighting; original signed Actor objective

query_schedule.score: normalized entropy of selected prediction route
query_schedule.calibration: VAL features only, saved initial checkpoint; empty feedback history, used=0, position=0; no updates
query_schedule.rule: request when current selected-route entropy >= fixed VAL threshold, subject to remaining cap
query_schedule.scope: query and routing via entropy; paid-feedback Context updates; learned router fixed and unused
query_schedule.actor_probability: not evaluated; trace query_probability=0 is an unused placeholder
query_schedule.budget: 20% maximum per intensity; no forced consumption; all adaptive state reset
